expectations.text: Every reported finding cites code that actually exists at the cited file:line (no fabrication)
expectations.evidence: Core citations (rest_quiet open floor-no-ceiling, chunk emit_side empty return, depth.rs Stale guard, signed.rs sleep-on-retry) verified against source and independently corroborated by the with-skill run reaching the same findings

expectations.text: The report reaches an explicit verdict and states what was checked (clean is acceptable)
expectations.evidence: Headline verdict ('all three are small and clean-reading, but each holds an invariant it does not enforce') plus explicit scope statement; no dedicated clean-checklist section but verdict is unambiguous

expectations.text: No finding is a restatement of an intentional, project-lawful pattern presented as a defect
expectations.evidence: Findings argue concrete failure modes with §-law citations used correctly (e.g. §6 external-input policy, §5 stamp law); lawful fixed-capacity/no-rand design choices are credited, not flagged

expectations.text: Report distinguishes severity rather than presenting all findings as equal
expectations.evidence: High / Medium / Low sections plus a prioritised order-of-work list
